scope: One replacement current-then-candidate paired STALE development pilot after a zero-call timestamp-boundary failure; no full-set expansion.

hard_limits.settlement: Every started attempt must have one terminal result with a unique response id, pinned model/provider, positive usage and authoritative cost. Any open attempt, duplicate id, over-reservation cost or unsettled liability fails.

runtime.scratch_database: One ephemeral migrated database per arm, provisioned and dropped by scripts/with_scratch_db.sh from postgres://memphant:memphant@localhost:5432/memphant.
runtime.retry_resume: No manual resend. Resume only through the generator's hash-bound checkpoint; never delete attempt ledgers or share caches between arms.

gate.pass: Both arms complete all 12 probes with zero provider, parser, degraded, receipt, trace, leakage or settlement failures; candidate has at least two net correctness wins, zero paired losses, no dimension regression, current evidence where expected and no stale-as-current evidence.
gate.kill: Any missing/failed call or receipt, paired loss, dimension regression, fewer than two net wins, leakage, stale-as-current evidence or unreconciled cost yields REJECTED_STOP_NO_BROADENING.
gate.no_broadening: No tuning on pilot answers. The 400-scenario run is forbidden without a passing gate and a new committed packet.
